crossRefs.note: When Ahithophel saw that his counsel was not followed, he saddled his donkey, arose, and went home, to his city, and…
He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary, and departed. He went away and hanged himself.

translations.web: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.
translations.bsb: so that I would prefer strangling and death over my life in this body.
translations.kjv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, and death rather than my life.
translations.asv: So that my soul chooseth strangling, And death rather than these my bones.
